Orchestration that
feels alive

Palm is a Python-first orchestration organism on Behavior Trees — for humans mid-flight, coding agents on MCP, and work that must wait, resume, and live in more than one process.

Simple at the core. Powerful at the edges. Honest about what is ready. Grown in seasons — not frozen for comfort.

Install & run Star on GitHub Tree-shaped scale →

Truth-seeking

One start path. One continue path. Debt named, not hidden. Dual truth is a bug.

Human + agent

Wizards that backtrack. Assist and MCP that speak the same job path — not a second product.

Grown, not built

Themes close when homes are proper. Ambition over empty process. Experimental by choice.

One organism

Palm is not a bag of scripts. It is a living system with a job spine, planes for traffic, and eyes on itself — so work can be complex without becoming spaghetti.

SPINE

Job path

Definition → pattern → job → effects → events. Behavior Trees hold business behavior. Graphs and product share named ports — not dual brains.

VERBS

Start & continue

Completers announce themselves. Palm starts work from interests or continues parked jobs on the wait plane. No private resume hooks.

PLACE

Workload book

Foreign bodies live as named places — spawn or adopt. Readiness gates honesty: dependency down → do not pretend the work can run.

SYSTEM

Boot · seats · capacity

Named boot, supervisor continuous loops, multi-claimer work drain in-process. Residual multi-process claim is named — not marketed as magic.

EYES

Vitality & Inspect

Living top of the kernel: seat walk, projection, benchmark tools. Doctor is packaging; vitality is physiology.

EDGE

Surfaces stay thin

CLI, Explorer, REST, MCP — transport and bind, not a second identity model. Prefer palm_assist for agents.

What you can do today

Mature enough to dogfood. Honest about remainder. Built for people who will extend Palm downward through registries.

🧙

Interactive wizards

Choices, collections, backtrack, summary, transactional commit. Resume after days in a new terminal.

🤖

Agents via MCP

Assist-first operator door. Progressive docs (palm://agent/card). Same flows humans run.

📦

Resources & providers

Declarative resources, registry providers, compositional palm-calls-palm. Speak to systems without forking core.

⚙️

Workloads (scout)

Pure engine + runners (local, neonroot, host opt-in). Wizard steps, CQRS, reactive follow-up. Isolation is place — not provider soup.

🫀

Living kernel

Session plane, system boot, supervisor, vitality, multi-claimer drain. Inspect product door. Capacity with eyes open.

🧬

Extension law

Pure palm/core. Register patterns, providers, storages, runners. Definition at the edge — not menus in the hub.

WHERE PALM IS GROWING

Tree before mesh

Scale is not “more threads and hope.” It is a tree of named places under a light center: work bodies and support bodies in the place book, home pointing up, projection of truth when authority is ready.

  • → Assembly (seed) — organism truth between boot and business; authoritative DNA
  • → Workload — control multi-process local and remote as places, not chaos
  • → Grove — multi-Palm organization when the local verbs are boring
  • → Living work — datasets, training flows, TinyML and models as places under Palm

Full map in the repo: docs/PALM.md · seed docs/vision/VISION-ASSEMBLY.md

TOPOLOGY (ILLUSTRATIVE)

Home points up. Places are tracked. Authority down → invalidate — do not lie.

Get Palm

PyPI name palmengine · import palm · CLI palm

Install & doctor

pip install "palmengine[cli]"
palm version --full
palm doctor
palm status
palm repl

Library host

from palm.app import ApplicationHost, DeploymentProfile

with ApplicationHost(
    profile=DeploymentProfile.all_in_one()
) as host:
    job = host.submit_flow("onboard")
    print(job.status)

Agents (MCP)

pip install "palmengine[mcp]"
# Prefer palm_assist — see docs/MCP.md
# PALM_MCP_IN_PROCESS=1  optional in-process surface

Progressive docs: resource palm://agent/card before the full skill.
